exposure: Planned birth setting (home, birth centre, hospital)
outcome: Neonatal admission to higher level hospital care
cohort: Women in New South Wales, Australia, with low-risk singleton pregnancies between 37-41 weeks gestation and spontaneous onset of labor, who planned to give birth at home, in a birth centre, or in a hospital between 2000 and 2012.
finding: Women who planned to give birth at home or in a birth centre had high rates of vaginal birth, even when transferred to a hospital.
